description:
About the company
 Our client is a fast-growing financial technology company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Join a very small engineering group as an early hire, working mostly on server-side code with some user-interface work. You will partner closely with technical leadership, influence how systems are designed and carry projects from concept to release with substantial independence.
 What you'll do
 - Deliver new product capabilities from concept to release, focusing mainly on server-side services and data flows, with occasional user-interface work.
 - Help broaden the product offering by bringing a new line out of its trial phase and connecting additional products to the existing platform.
 - Guide technical decisions on deployment, reliability, capacity and the long-range shape of the system.
 - Create internal tools that let non-engineering colleagues solve problems themselves and cut down on requests to the engineering team.
 - Use AI-assisted coding tools to work quickly across the whole stack.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 6 to 12+ years of experience taking production features from start to finish as an individual contributor.
 - Working knowledge of relational databases and API design.
 - Proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript.
 - Experience in a young, fast-moving company, or leading brand-new product builds inside a larger organization.
 - Self-directed, proactive and comfortable with ambiguity.
 - Regular hands-on use of AI-assisted coding tools.
 - Experience with products sold through intermediaries to end users.
 - Knowledge of financial services or insurance, or a genuine interest in the space.
 - Ability to work on-site 4 days per week.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 150,000 to 300,000 per year
 - Equity
 - Relocation assistance
 Location and work model
 - New York, NY, United States
 - Hybrid, 4 days per week in the office
 - Full-time
